subject: Procurement kickoff & vendor onboarding - Acme Retail
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff & vendor onboarding - Acme Retail

Hi Alice / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We'd like to kick off the vendor onboarding and procurement process so we can align on timelines and get you on dedicated capacity once the contract is in place. Proposed agenda:
- Introductions (AE/SE/CSM + Acme procurement, security)
- Procurement checklist & required evidence (SOC2, data retention, KMS)
- Technical onboarding steps (network allowlist, test account)
- Mutual Action Plan / timeline to PO/signature

Proposed slots next week (all PST):
- Tue 7/7 10:00-11:00
- Wed 7/8 14:00-15:00
- Thu 7/9 09:00-10:00

I attached a short onboarding checklist and a SOC 2 summary to help the procurement/security folks review in advance. Can you confirm which slot works or share alternatives?

Next steps: once we lock a time I'll send a calendar invite and a draft mutual action plan (we can DocuSign the SOW/Order once the timeline is agreed).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff & vendor onboarding - Acme Retail

Thanks Marissa 


 appreciate the doc.

We can do Wed 7/8 14:00 PST (that's 17:00 our time) but I'd like to make sure our security lead joins. Looping in Tom (security) and procurement@acme.com.

Quick Q: procurement here typically needs a 10-14 day window for PO approvals once we have the mutual action plan. Would that fit your expected timeline? Also, please include a high-level list of what evidence you provide for security (SOC2 + any pen test summaries).

Thanks,
Alice
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Retail
alice.nguyen@acme.com

Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff & vendor onboarding - Acme Retail

Hi Alice 
  I can join Wed 7/8 14:00 PST. A couple items for security/procurement to know ahead of the call:
- We provide SOC 2 Type II summary and documentation (see attached). Full reports available under NDA.
- Network requirements: allowlist outbound to 34.201.45.0/24 and 52.23.100.0/24; we can also provide a customer-dedicated VPC if needed.
- Key management: we support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) and HSM integrations 
  
 we can include the KMS integration steps in the onboarding doc.

I'll be prepared to walk through the technical onboarding steps and answer any questions.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Attachment: network_requirements.pdf

Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff & vendor onboarding - Acme Retail

Marissa / team,

We prefer Thu 7/9 09:00 PST if that still works (seems earlier in the week is packed for our procurement folks). If not, Wed 7/8 14:00 PST will do. Please send a calendar invite with dial-in details and attendee list.

Also: our procurement timeline is typically 10 business days from mutual action plan approval to PO issuance, occasionally longer if Legal needs to redline. Please flag any non-standard terms up front (data residency, indemnity caps, SLAs) so we can route correctly.

Thanks,
Acme Procurement
procurement@acme.com
